whole_s: producer run elapsed, includes fresh original verification; excludes initial loading and manifest publication
whole_including_loading_and_publication_: entire measured request including loading and publication
local_original_s: sum of local job durations; overlaps for parallel_local_proofs>1; NOT an elapsed partition
local_core_s: sum of core durations within local originals; overlaps for parallel jobs
charged_peak_bytes: SharedHostBudget high-water mark; not whole-process RSS
